widget.title: Pipelines Running Security Scans

queries.query:
find view "view:sto:scan" s
| join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h_l on h_l.parent_unique_id = s.parent_unique_id and h_l.account_identifier = s.account_identifier
| left join view "view:sto:account_product" p on p.id = s.product_id and p.account_identifier = s.account_identifier
| left join view "view:sto:target_variant" tv on tv.id = s.target_variant_id
| left join view "view:sto:target" t on t.id = tv.target_id
| filter s.is_deleted = false
    and s.created >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and s.created <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
    and ${org_filter_predicate}
    and ${project_filter_predicate}
    and ${target_filter_predicate}
    and ${scanner_filter_predicate}
    and ${pipeline_filter_predicate}
| select {
    h_l.project_identifier as project,
    s.pipeline_identifier as pipeline,
    count() as scans,
    distinct_count(s.plan_execution_id) as executions,
    distinct_count(s.product_id) as scanners,
    distinct_count(tv.target_id) as targets,
    round(sum(case when s.status = "Succeeded" then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / count(), 1) as success_rate,
    avg(date_diff(s.created, s.last_modified, "second")) as avg_scan_duration,
    max(s.created) as last_scan
}
| group_by h_l.project_identifier, s.pipeline_identifier
| order_by scans desc
| limit 50

widget.subtitle: Which pipelines enforce security scanning, with how many scanners and how reliably

widget.title: Targets Without Recent Scans

queries.query:
with last_scans as (
  find view "view:sto:target_variant" tv
  | join view "view:sto:scan" s on s.target_variant_id = tv.id
  | filter s.is_deleted = false
  | select { tv.target_id as target_id, max(s.created) as last_scan }
  | group_by tv.target_id
)
find view "view:sto:target" t
| join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h_l on h_l.parent_unique_id = t.parent_unique_id and h_l.account_identifier = t.account_identifier
| join last_scans ls on ls.target_id = t.id
| filter t.is_deleted = false
    and ls.last_scan < cast(${start_time} as timestamp)
    and ls.last_scan <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
    and ${org_filter_predicate}
    and ${project_filter_predicate}
    and ${target_filter_predicate}
| select {
    t.name as target,
    t.type as target_type,
    h_l.project_identifier as project,
    ls.last_scan as last_scan,
    date_diff(ls.last_scan, now(), "second") as time_since_scan
}
| order_by last_scan desc
| limit 100

widget.subtitle: Registered targets with no scan in the selected period (coverage gaps)

widget.title: Exemptions In Effect
widget.subtitle: Approved or pending exemptions active at any point in the period

widget.title: Active STO Users

queries.query:
find view "view:sto:usage" u
| filter u.created >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and u.created <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
    and u.usage_type = "User"
| select { distinct_count(u.resource_id) as active_sto_users }
| limit 1

widget.subtitle: Distinct users counted toward STO licensing in the period

widget.title: Billable Scan Events

queries.query:
find view "view:sto:usage" u
| filter u.created >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and u.created <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
    and u.usage_type = "Scan"
| select { count() as scan_usage_events }
| limit 1

widget.subtitle: Scan usage events recorded for STO licensing

widget.subtitle: Lifecycle state of exemptions in effect during the period

widget.title: Exempted Issues by Severity

queries.query:
find view "view:sto:exemption" e
| left join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h_l on h_l.parent_unique_id = e.parent_unique_id and h_l.account_identifier = e.account_identifier
| filter e.is_deleted = false
    and e.created <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
    and (e.expiration is null or e.expiration >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp))
    and ${org_filter_predicate}
    and ${project_filter_predicate}
    and ${severity_filter_predicate}
| select {
    e.issue_severity_code as severity,
    (case
        when e.issue_severity_code = "Critical" then 5
        when e.issue_severity_code = "High" then 4
        when e.issue_severity_code = "Medium" then 3
        when e.issue_severity_code = "Low" then 2
        when e.issue_severity_code = "Info" then 1
        else 0
    end) as severity_order,
    e.status as status,
    count() as exemptions
}
| group_by e.issue_severity_code, severity_order, e.status
| order_by severity_order desc
| limit 100

widget.subtitle: Accepted risk by issue severity, split by exemption status

widget.title: STO Usage Trend

queries.query:
find view "view:sto:usage" u
| filter u.created >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and u.created <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| select {
    date_trunc("week", u.created) as usage_week,
    u.usage_type as usage_type,
    count() as events
}
| group_by usage_week, u.usage_type
| order_by usage_week asc
| limit 500

widget.subtitle: Weekly STO usage events by type (scans, users, AI assists)

widget.title: Exemption Register

queries.query:
find view "view:sto:exemption" e
| left join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h_l on h_l.parent_unique_id = e.parent_unique_id and h_l.account_identifier = e.account_identifier
| filter e.is_deleted = false
    and e.created <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
    and (e.expiration is null or e.expiration >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp))
    and ${org_filter_predicate}
    and ${project_filter_predicate}
    and ${severity_filter_predicate}
| select {
    e.issue_title as issue,
    e.issue_severity_code as severity,
    e.status as status,
    e.type as exemption_type,
    e.reason as reason,
    (case
        when e.pipeline_identifier is not null then "Pipeline"
        when e.target_id is not null then "Target"
        when h_l.project_identifier is not null and h_l.project_identifier != "" then "Project"
        when h_l.org_identifier is not null and h_l.org_identifier != "" then "Organization"
        else "Account"
    end) as scope,
    h_l.project_identifier as project,
    (case
        when e.expiration is null then "Never expires"
        when e.expiration < now() then "Lapsed"
        else "Time-bound"
    end) as expiry,
    e.created as requested
}
| order_by requested desc
| limit 200

widget.subtitle: Audit trail of every exemption in effect: severity, status, justification, scope and expiry
